extract_policy: All full-report fields except the per-run sensitivity array; regenerate with aa-lcr-pruning.
interpretation: One review per fixed answer cannot identify judge nondeterminism or bias.
Seed variation and design intervals condition on stored grades, not judge reruns.
Cross-model disagreements mix capability, generation and grading; not judge replicates.
Flip budgets are hypothetical upper bounds, not measured or probabilistic flip rates.
Sensitivity holds reference features and selection fixed; reference-label refitting is unmeasured.
Design-plus-flip bounds widen finite-pool intervals by b/N for a fixed latent grade table.
They retain design coverage only conditional on at most b errors, not judge correctness.
At census sampling uncertainty vanishes; judge uncertainty remains unidentified.
repeat_judging_plan: Freeze prompts, answers, rubric and judge version. Rejudge every answer at least 3 times with independent calls, retaining every grade, seed and configuration. Report within-answer disagreement, per-model repeat-score variation and paired rank changes; resample document sets and judge replicates separately. Use human adjudication to assess systematic bias.
